authority: North Star Product Board -> product architecture -> screen/block/slot contracts -> asset production

screens.name: Splash / Loading
screens.job: Enter the world, establish tone, and recover boot state.

screens.name: House Hub
screens.job: Read persistent House progress, resources, and the next useful action.

screens.name: Chapters
screens.job: Choose a House wing without losing global context.

screens.name: Chapter Detail / Curio Boutique Route
screens.job: Choose an available display/level inside the active chapter.

screens.name: Level Pre-start
screens.job: Understand level objective, reward, move budget, aids, then start intentionally.

screens.name: Match-3 Gameplay
screens.job: Solve the active puzzle with clear goals and trustworthy feedback.

screens.name: Win / Rewards
screens.job: Explain success, granted reward, and the persistent consequence before leaving gameplay.

screens.name: House Restoration
screens.job: Show the persistent same-camera House change caused by a first-time win.

screens.name: Curio Collection
screens.job: Inspect owned Curios and understand missing ones.

screens.name: Weekly Missions
screens.job: Track truthful weekly goals and claim valid rewards.

screens.name: Event Center
screens.job: Discover live/coming events without fabricating availability.

screens.name: Shop
screens.job: Expose only truthful economy offers; no real purchase until commerce exists.

screens.name: Profile / Settings
screens.job: Inspect player progress and control presentation/accessibility settings.
